MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The locking nut assortment feels useful alongside my hose clamps and electrical connectors because it offers practical fastening options for repairs.",
    "The adhesive VELCRO strips fit my interest in securing things and give me a removable way to attach small accessories."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The fluorescent green gaffer tape resembles supplies I have bought, but its marking color serves a purpose I do not currently need.",
    "The angle gauge, feeler gauge, flap discs and wire wheel require specific measuring or metalworking tasks that my purchases do not establish.",
    "The outdoor light control, safety can and glow sticks do not solve a current problem suggested by my repair supplies."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying clamps and connectors seems to have been taken as a reason to recommend a broad range of workshop tools.",
    "My tape purchases seem to have been treated as interest in any heavy-duty tape, overlooking whether its particular purpose fits."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection across my tapes, cement, clamps and connectors is attaching, joining or securing things.",
    "A specialized tool needs a matching task; owning general repair supplies does not mean I currently need precision measurement or grinding equipment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical repairs but stretched it into specialized tasks that my history does not support."
}
